## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers to trace a Sling request from URL to resolved Resource, request information, resource type hierarchy, selected script or servlet and response using observable evidence.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 4 of a seven-week AEM Sites training course, delivered Thursday, August 20, 2026. The audience already knows JCR nodes, properties, Sling Resources and the responsibilities of /content, /conf and /apps. This class focuses on the resource-first Sling request model, URL decomposition after resource resolution, resource types, super types and handler selection. Supplied evidence can replace a live environment.",
    "core_claim": "A reliable Sling request trace follows evidence in order: request URL and method, resolved Resource, RequestPathInfo, resource type hierarchy, selected handler and response.",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "SlingHttpServletRequest",
      "Resource",
      "ResourceResolver",
      "RequestPathInfo",
      "resource path",
      "selectors",
      "extension",
      "suffix",
      "HTTP method",
      "sling:resourceType",
      "sling:resourceSuperType",
      "HTL script",
      "servlet"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Use the already approved sample image exactly as the final slide."
  }
}

  "texture_and_finish": "Flat 2D technical diagrams with fine rules, restrained headers, precise folder, request, resource and code icons. No gradients, neon, glass, 3D or photography.",
